releases.summary: Refined the idle screen for better readability.

changes.text: Enlarged the bottom guidance text and icons.
Strengthened the background gradient so guidance stays legible over bright photos and videos.

releases.summary: Internal cleanup with no visible change on screen.

changes.text: Internal maintenance only; nothing changes for daily use.
Input from a previous step no longer carries over during the multi-step password change (verify current, enter new, confirm new). Applies to both admin and technician passwords.
Developer diagnostics improvement; no user-facing change.
Grouped Auto Setup, Manual Cleaning, and Reset Sequence under a single Maintenance menu.
Moved Manual Cleaning where store operators can reach it directly.
The original file name and format are now preserved for slideshow media.
Settings > About now shows the actual installed app version.
The download screen appears instantly when you tap Install now.
The screen no longer closes on its own while an update is in progress.

releases.summary: Added manual cleaning and made the cleaning cycle more reliable.

changes.text: Run a cleaning cycle directly from Settings > Maintenance (after closing the door).
Confirms the nozzle has lowered to the cleaning position before starting.
Fixed an issue where the cleaning spray did not stop.

releases.summary: Added remote media for the slideshows.

changes.text: Add image, video, or zip URLs and the app downloads and displays them automatically.
Works alongside manually uploaded media, with a Sync now button.
The machine returns to its home position after mixing, before serving the drink.
The mixing descent now always stays within the safe height range.
Added the Strawberry Mango Blueberry Smoothie.
Fine-tuned the brewing positions.

releases.summary: Added a reset (abort) function for in-progress drinks.

changes.text: Safely stop a drink in progress and return to idle: reset only, or reset and return to the home position.
Water, motors, and other outputs shut off safely when a drink is aborted.
Tuned the machine's default motion speed for better stability.
Applied internal settings for the production hardware configuration.
